verdict.rationale: The docs show code diffs as reviewable Artifacts with a 'Review Changes' flow, file diff viewers and a hide-whitespace filter. The agent halts for explicit approval before applying changes, and checks can run via test-running subagents, hooks that execute shell commands, headless CI integration and isolated Git worktrees. missing for 10: explicit pre-merge/PR gating or merge workflow documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of the diff-review and check-running flow.
